name: Algorithmic_Equivalence_Framing
description: Frame the certificates using direct numeric checks (as requested by the expert) but describe the aggregation using algorithmic reduction language ("minimum time required ... processed back-to-back") rather than the explicit word "sum". This satisfies the expert's demand for clear scheduling semantics while testing if the model can map the physical description of a zero-idle-time schedule to the arithmetic sum of durations.
